purpose: Test whether task-scoped knowledge recorded by Aimee's no-progress stop changes the next attempt enough to produce an edit, regression test, or completed repair instead of repeating broad retrieval.

conditions.aimee_learned_retry: Production Go economizer and write-progress controller, with production-equivalent goal-scoped failed-approach recall derived only from the sealed prior run.

fixed_controls: same task and base system prompt
same economizer and progress-controller thresholds as the sealed failure
intervention: Before the first provider call, inject the task-scoped failed approach and measured stop evidence using the same prior_failure_learning wording as the production retry path. No solution, target file, hidden test, or later-fix information is injected.
secondary_outcomes: a successful repository mutation occurs before 28 successful non-mutating tool calls
provider-reported billable input and output tokens
success_claim: A learned-retry completion requires hidden grader passes. A behavior-change claim requires an earlier successful mutation, a regression-sensitive authored test, or a terminal reason other than progress_abort. Token savings are reported descriptively against the sealed source run and are not a population estimate.
stopping_rule: Run the single planned learned retry to submit, assistant final, provider/context failure, progress abort, or 30 turns. Do not change the learned evidence, thresholds, prompts, task, grader, or stopping rules after dispatch begins.
interpretation_guardrail: This is a sequential within-task demonstration from one sealed failure and one retry, not an independent paired estimate or population claim.
